```{python}
#| echo: false

import pandas as pd
from itables import show
from IPython.display import HTML, display

df = pd.read_csv("Individuals.csv")
display(HTML('<div data-pagefind-body style="display:none">' + df.to_html(index=False, escape=True)    + '</div>'))

df.insert(0, "#", range(1, len(df) + 1))
#hidden = []

show(
    df,
    #columnDefs=[{"targets": hidden, "visible": False},       ],
    paging=True,
    pageLength=10,
    scrollX=True,
    classes="display compact",
    layout={
        "topStart": ["buttons"],
        "topEnd": ["search"],
        "bottomStart": ["pageLength"],
        "bottomEnd": ["paging"] ,
    },
    buttons=["colvis"],
    allow_html=True,
)
```
